prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: a bicycle mechanic diagnosing a wheel, choosing a wrench, adjusting a spoke and testing the wheel spin, showing a task loop that uses tools and feedback.
Scene/backdrop: a small open neighborhood bicycle repair shop with a real bike on a stand, hand tools nearby, no paperwork.
Style/medium: candid documentary photography, grounded workwear and worn metal textures, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, mechanic's hands, wheel and focused face visible, no graphic overlay.
Lighting/mood: practical daylight from an open door with a restrained red practical accent deeper in the shop, focused and capable.
Color palette: warm near-black shadows, dark steel, natural skin tones, restrained red.
Constraints: no readable text, logos or watermark.
Avoid: screens, documents, office, robots, holograms, futuristic effects, generic AI clichés, staged stock photo.
